$comment: Image types an agent chat accepts: the formats the model reads as a native image content block, by file extension, with their media type. A subset of attachments.json importExtensions (svg, avif, bmp and heic are importable into a note but the model cannot read them). Read by src-tauri/src/agent/images.rs (include_str!) and features/agent/web/lib/chat-images.ts (JSON import); the size cap is attachments.json maxBytes. Spec: SPECs/native-agent-spec.md, Images in the composer.
